name: Endeavour Group Ltd/Australia
summary: Endeavour Group Limited, an Australian entity, operates across the retail drinks and hospitality sectors. The company's business model is structured around its Retail, Hotels, and Other segments. It is engaged in the production and sale of beverages, while also providing a comprehensive suite of hotel-related services that include food and drink offerings, accommodation, entertainment, and gaming opportunities. Endeavour Group boasts a substantial footprint, managing 1,675 retail stores under its prominent Dan Murphy's and BWS brands, in addition to 344 hotels. Incorporated in 2012, its principal office is located in Surry Hills, Australia.
